newsitem.title: USA: Vincam to buy Staff Administrators. [CORRECTED 18:55 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Vincam to buy Staff Administrators. [CORRECTED 18:55 GMT]

text.p: The Vincam Group Inc said Thursday it signed a letter of intent to buy Staff Administrators Inc, a privately-held professional employer organization, for undisclosed terms.
The company said the transaction was expected to be accretive (corrects from "was not expected") to earnings per share in 1997.
The deal would be accounted for as a pooling of interests and was subject to certain factors, the company said.
Staff Administrators is headquartered in Denver, and employes about 3,600 people on site.
